text:
alex: Heads-up — AcmeFin POC using Go SDK v0.3.2 behind corporate proxy. After ~30m they hit FD exhaustion and app crashes. Anyone seen keepalive/connection leaks with proxies?

maria-sales: cc @raj-eng @eva-sdks — customer on a tight timeline, POC demo Tuesday. They can't give us a lot of ops time.

raj-eng: What proxy type/version? Any logs or config? Is this for streaming or request/response?

alex: Proxy is a Squid 4.x (CONNECT tunneling). Using streaming chat endpoint (server-sent events style). Quick log snippet from their app: 

```
2026-03-20T09:12:34Z ERROR http: roundtrip error: tls handshake timeout
2026-03-20T09:12:34Z WARN  http: response status 502 from proxy
2026-03-20T09:12:34Z INFO  open fds: 1024 (limit 1024) -> OOM
2026-03-20T09:12:35Z ERROR post /v1/chat: context deadline exceeded
```

They also see lots of TIME_WAIT sockets and many connections in CLOSE_WAIT on the client.

tim-ops: That pattern smells like connections not being closed when the proxy returns an error during CONNECT for streaming. Go's http.Transport will try to reuse sockets unless bodies are fully read/closed. With streaming we often keep the body open and rely on server to close. If proxy returns 502 mid-setup, you can leak the underlying connection.

alex: Their minimal http.Transport: 

```
tr := &http.Transport{
  Proxy: http.ProxyFromEnvironment,
  MaxIdleConns: 100,
  MaxIdleConnsPerHost: 10,
  IdleConnTimeout: 90 * time.Second,
}
client := &http.Client{Transport: tr, Timeout: 0}
```

They didn't set DisableKeepAlives.

eva-sdks: We've hit a similar report internally. In v0.3.2 the streaming connection lifecycle didn't properly close when the proxy returned non-2xx on CONNECT during handshake. Proxy error path left the net.Conn referenced by transport idle pool; GC doesn't reclaim until socket timeout leading to FD exhaustion. Issue filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/issues/412 (internal link).

alex: What immediate workaround can we give the customer? They need something low-risk to apply for the demo.

tim-ops: Quick workaround options (ranked):
1) Set DisableKeepAlives: true on Transport — forces new TCP for each request (ugly but stops reuse/leak).
2) Set MaxIdleConnsPerHost = 0 — prevents idling per-host; similar effect.
3) Force HTTP/1.1 by clearing TLSNextProto to avoid http2 multiplexing edge cases behind proxy.

Note: 1 & 2 increase CPU/TCP cost and latency; but it's safe and easy for a POC.

eva-sdks: For POC add this small wrapper as a stopgap (example): 

```
tr := &http.Transport{
  Proxy: http.ProxyFromEnvironment,
  DisableKeepAlives: true,
  MaxIdleConns: 0,
  MaxIdleConnsPerHost: 0,
  IdleConnTimeout: 10 * time.Second,
}
client := &http.Client{Transport: tr, Timeout: 0}
```

We also recommend toggling GODEBUG=netdns=go to reduce DNS surprises, and if they can use a direct egress rule for the POC that bypasses corporate proxy that will prove it's proxy-related.

alex: Perfect — can you confirm any SDK patch or ETA? I need to tell the SRE and the customer.

eva-sdks: We'll backport a fix to ensure the transport drains and closes the underlying connection on proxy error paths in v0.3.3. Target: release candidate tonight, GA tomorrow. PR: #527 (will share changelog).

sara-support: I can apply the DisableKeepAlives workaround in their demo environment and monitor. Want me to push the config change and restart their app?

maria-sales: Yes please — do it and I will update the customer. Also, any guidance about impact on cost/latency so we set expectations?

tim-ops: Expect ~10-30ms added latency per request and more TCP churn. For the demo traffic levels it should be negligible; for production we want the SDK patch + tuned idle limits.

eva-sdks: After we ship v0.3.3 we'll provide a short upgrade note: revert DisableKeepAlives if applied, bump MaxIdleConnsPerHost to 100, set IdleConnTimeout to 90s. We'll include a small test harness to repro the proxy 502 and verify fix.

alex: Thanks everyone — please @mention me in the PR and confirm when you pushed the workaround. I'll close loop with AcmeFin.

sara-support: Done — applied workaround at 2026-03-20T11:20Z, monitoring. Will update when counters stable. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: release v0.3.3-rc1 built (artifact: go-sdk-v0.3.3-rc1.tar.gz)

alex: Great — I'll message the customer with ETA and the temporary config.
